description: SGLang is a high-performance serving framework for large language models and multimodal models.
summary: SGLang sits underneath a lot of the agentic-inference plumbing I maintain: PenguPool routes many concurrent sessions and AgentOn Pocket needs low-latency replies on the phone side, so a serving layer that is actually tuned for multi-turn, tool-calling workloads instead of single-shot completions spares me from hand-tuning vLLM flags for the hundredth time. The Apple Silicon / Metal path is the detail that keeps it local-first friendly for Oh Tidepool's on-device tide math, and the structured-generation core—radix attention, constrained decoding, speculative decoding via SpecForge—is the kind of systems work that removes a whole class of prompt-plumbing toil I would otherwise rebuild per project. I'll skip the summit and Slack energy, but the engine itself is the right substrate for Proreerfolio's job-fit checks, where I need grounded, structured outputs without paying for a cloud GPU.
